source: IANA tz database 2026d (data.iana.org) — zone1970.tab + region source files + etcetera
primary_key_note: auto-increment integer starting at 1, unique within this table
link_column_note: the value held in the 9-bit tz_id field of the 64-bit timestamp = round(utc_offset_seconds/900) + 256
description: IANA timezone reference table (local — comprehensive per-zone catalog). Primary key ``timezone_id`` is a 1-based auto-increment id. A file's 9-bit tz_id value is matched against the ``tz_slot`` column when the local_tz flag = 1. One row per real IANA canonical zone plus the Etc/GMT* fixed-offset zones; the Etc/GMT* rows use timezone_id = the offset bucket so an offset-only timestamp resolves. All names and offsets are verbatim from the IANA tz database 2026d; nothing is synthesized.
